source_cohort: previously frozen 100%-coverage paired cohort after excluding acquisitions with only 5 or 10 movie frames
ranking: descending directly observed paired relative-vector MSCD at the supported lag nearest 10 s
important_boundary: The rank uses a directly observed acquisition-supported lag, not an interpolated or fitted exact-10-s value. Exact observed lag is retained per case.
physical_interpretation: descriptive high-relative-motion case screen, not a state label
